name: esp32s3_devkit
title: ESP32-S3 DevKit, 16 MB, 8 MB PSRAM
description: A standard ESP32-S3 dev board with two USB-C ports, a CH343 USB bridge on one of them, an RGB LED and a BOOT button
notes: A board sold by many makers, so no maker is written and no schematic was read.
The RGB LED is on GPIO 48 on the unit tried. On some boards of this kind it is on GPIO 38.

pins.notes: s3_led: red on GPIO 48 and no blue on GPIO 38, green while BOOT is held.

chip.notes: ESP32-S3 rev 0.2, embedded PSRAM 8 MB, flash 16 MB, the port is a CH343. esp_psram finds 8 MB with the octal mode of sdkconfig.defaults.
